items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: somebody asked me to, uh, go up there and help out in the recording booth... I don't claim any

ctx.x: Well, my first recording session that I worked on in any capacity at all, uh, which is strange, was, uh, uh, on a recording of the Andrew Sisters by Mir Bistachain, which, uh, uh, the first session that I made under my own aegis, as it were, was a record of Dan Burley called Chicken Shack Shuffled, uh, 78, with, uh, Pop Sposter and Danny Barker and Jimmy Archie.
What were you doing with the Andrew Sisters? Uh, should I ask?

Well, all that I was doing is that, uh, somebody asked me to, uh, go up there and help out in the recording booth, because somebody who was supposed to have shown up had not. Mm-hmm. And, uh, that, that was all there was to that. I, I don't claim any, but that's the time, that's when I met Bobby Hackett, who played on that.
